No broad API, compiler or runtime verification.

files.reviewScope: Full bounded JSON metadata parser and session_phase transitions; lines 1-183.
Read proposed pure parser/phase checks; no execution.
Bootstrap begin/bind wrapper, first describe authorization acquisition, shutdown observation and cleanup: lines 207-324, 390-489, 553-590; final count wiring located statically.

staticConclusions: The wrapper enters bootstrap-in-flight before calling the real SDK, binds session/origin from its successful correlated response before returning that same response, and does not copy bearer tokens into observation metadata.

The phase guard permits at most one nonempty opaque lifecycle retirement before bootstrap and before probe work; in-flight or bound premature shutdown, repeated bootstrap, wrong closing identity and duplicate bound close are rejected.
The first describe still requires an active matching authorization scope; later requests require the same scope pointer and session/origin.

The metadata reader bounds bytes/depth/node count, validates JSON syntax and UTF-8/escapes/surrogate pairs, rejects duplicate keys including escaped equivalents, and requires correctly typed projected fields.

The analyzer requires exactly one bootstrap begin and binding, at most one pre-bootstrap retirement, and one bound close after finish and before host destruction, with matching identities and final counts.
